meta.title: OCI manager Apps | ProxMenux
meta.description: Run official OCI images as native Proxmox VE LXC containers, with persistent data, devices, multi-container applications and transactional updates.

header.title: OCI manager Apps
header.description: Official OCI images run as native Proxmox VE LXC containers. The image stays the one its maintainer publishes; ProxMenux reproduces the environment Docker Compose would have created around it.

calloutInfo.title: One OCI image, one native LXC
calloutInfo.body: No Docker engine runs inside the containers. Proxmox VE imports the image's filesystem and its OCI metadata, and the application becomes the main process of a native LXC, managed with the same tools as any other container of the node.

flow.caption: The application is not rebuilt: its environment is reproduced declaratively.

sections.title: Where it is
sections.intro: OCI manager Apps opens from option OCI manager Apps (beta) of the ProxMenux main menu, on the Proxmox node and as root. Its first screen offers:

items: Search applications — search by name across the catalog.
All applications — the complete catalog, with the number of applications.
Manage installed OCI applications — update, recreate, remove or recover what was installed.
Install an image that is not in the catalog — translate a Compose file, a docker run command or an image reference.
The catalog categories, each with its number of applications.

figure.alt: Main screen of OCI manager Apps with search, all applications, management, custom image and the catalog categories
figure.caption: Main screen of OCI manager Apps.

blocks.p: Selecting an application shows its description, the image it runs and two installation modes: Install with default settings, which asks almost nothing, and Install with advanced settings, which offers the real storage, bridge and resource selectors of the node.

sections.title: What Docker expresses and what OCI manager Apps turns it into

headers: OCI manager Apps turns it into
rows: OCI rootfs and the main process of the LXC
a persistent mpN disk included in the backup, or a host directory
an address of its own for the LXC and the access URL of the service
devN entries with the effective host GID and a validated profile
a private bridge, fixed addresses, start order and healthchecks
a new rootfs with the same persistent contract

sections.title: What is kept and what changes

items.title: Kept
items.body: The official image, its internal paths, its environment, its startup process and its functional documentation.

items.title: Adapted
items.body: The runtime environment: network, persistence, devices, permissions and dependencies use native Proxmox VE LXC primitives.

items.title: Not translated
items.body: A Compose key with no safe equivalent is listed as a blocker. Templates with blockers are not offered, and sensitive options are confirmed during the installation.

items.title: Recorded
items.body: Image digest, resources, paths, network, devices and stack membership are stored in the instance contract, which updates and recreations reproduce.
